# Weekly team meeting notes format

## Knowledge

We take meeting notes in a shared doc with sections: Agenda, Decisions,
Action Items. Notes are archived in the wiki after the meeting.

## Consequence

No code impact. This memory is a deliberate distractor for retrieval benchmarks.
